out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including HAND WASHING, as it relates to their assigned duties.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. PROVIDED INSTRUCTIONS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: Employees are not properly sanitizing cleaned multiuse equipment and utensils before they are reused.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train his/her employees to properly sanitize all equipment, utensils, and surfaces after being cleaned using either an approved sanitizer at the adequate concentration or heat sanitization at the proper temperature to destroy pathogenic bacteria. PROVIDED GUIDELINES TO THE MANAGER ON DUTY.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. PROVIDED THE MANAGER WITH EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY WEBLINK TO HAVE IT PRINTED.

violations.title: Employees Informed of Responsibility to Report
violations.observation: Employees are not aware of the reporting procedures concerning information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall inform all food employees and conditional employees of their responsibility to report any information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissable through food as specified under 2-201.11(A). THERE WILL BE A FOLLOW-UP TO ENSURE THE EMPLOYEES HAVE SIGNED THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY AND UNDERSTAND THEIR RESPONSIBILITY TO REPORT ILLNESS.

violations.title: DOK Restriction and Exclusion
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to relate how the person in charge, food employees, and conditional employees comply with disease reporting responsibilities and exclusion or restriction of food employees.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge is responsible for ensuring that food employees and conditional employees are trained and aware of their responsibilities with regards to reportable symptoms, exposures, and diagnosis. PROVIDED INSTRUCTIONS TO THE MANAGER ON DUTY.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. PROVIDED THE LINK TO PRINT THE EMPLOYEE HELATH POLICY DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Employee returned to kitchen and began handling food without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PROVIDED GUIDELINES ON WHEN TO WASH HANDS DURING INSPECTION. THE EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS DURING AS INSTRUCTED.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PROVIDED PROPER HAND WASHING INSTRUCTIONS TO THE OPERATOR DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. THE OPERATOR PROVIDED HAND SINK DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the facility is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. The hand sink had a hose connected to fill the cooking pots near by.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. THE OPERATOR REMOVED THE HOSE DURING INSPECTION AS INSTRUCTED.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PROVIDED HAND WASHING SIGNS WEB LINK TO THE MANAGER ON DUTY

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: COOKING CONTAINERS. EMPLOYEES WAS WASHING DISHES AT THE 3-VAT SINK WITHOUT SANITIZING DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PROVIDED INSTRUCTIONS ON PROPER SANITIZATION AT THE 3-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION. THE EMPLOYEE SET UP SANITIZER STATION AS INSTRUCTED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked Pork intestine (44F), Cooked Chicken (44F), Cooked Ground Pork (44F) in 2-Dr Prep Refrg.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. FOOD ITEMS WERE MOVED TO UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR TO COOL DURING INSPECTION. FOOD ITEMS WERE COOLED TO 41F DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Cooked - beef intestine, chicken, ground pork in the prep refrigerator and upright refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Food items were dated marked during inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Oil, soy sauce, sugar syrup in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO LABEL ALL THE WORKING CONTAINERS AND STORAGE CONTAINERS DURING INSPECTION. GAIMA RICE BOWL (Inspection Date: 11/18/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS ON THE FLOOR BELOW THE HAND SINK AND STORAGE AREAS IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PROVIDED INSTRUCTIONS TO STORE FOOD ITEMS ON THE SHELF DURING INSPECTION

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. INSTRUCTED THE OPERATOR TO REMOVE WET WIPE FROM THE COUNTER AND STORE IT IN SANITIZER SOLUTION DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: RICE SCOOPS IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER AT 64F
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. THE OPERATOR CLEANED THE RICE SCOOPS AND PLACED IT IN DRY CONTAINER DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Self-service utensils (spoons) at the POS area was stored improperly.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. THE OPERATOR CORRECTED THIS ITEM DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: RICE WARMER, MEAT SLICER
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE REMOVE THESE ITEMS FROM THE FACILITY. IF AND WHEN REPLACING THESE ITEMS, PLEASE ENSURE THESE ITEMS ARE NSF OR EQUIVALENT. PLEASE SUBMIT THE SPECIFICATION SHEET TO HEALTH DEPARTMENT FOR REVIEW.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard boxes uses as self liner in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CARDBOARD BOXES WERE REMOVED DURING INSPECTION

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.
